about: Notification pop-ups like Windows 11 toasts: bottom-right corner, 12 px from the screen edge and the taskbar, Windows' width, no line under the app name and no timeout bar, the picture on the left, action buttons filling the row with equal widths, a monochrome close glyph, Windows 11's "..." menu (turn the app's notifications off, notification settings) instead of KDE's settings button and no bell in the tray (the clock opens the notification centre, like Windows 11). Matched against plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13). Jobs in a toast (Firefox downloads through Plasma's browser integration, file copies) show Windows 11's thin progress bar with bytes, speed and percentage under it and equal-width buttons: Pause/Resume and Cancel, then Open file and Open folder.

topInset: 0
        background: null // VeltOS: no line under the app name, like Windows
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.columnSpan: delegateRoot.__firstColumn + 2
